scope: closed testnet only; private telemetry; no credentials or endpoints

alerts.condition: a role reports a genesis or approved-build digest different from the release record
alerts.immediateAction: quarantine the role from P2P, stop AVR ingress, preserve evidence and investigate; do not reset history

alerts.condition: a closed-testnet RPC listener is reachable outside the approved private boundary
alerts.immediateAction: remove external exposure, rotate affected gateway credentials, preserve access evidence and review before resuming ingress

alerts.condition: independent validators disagree on canonical hash beyond the observation window, or an invalid block/proof/AVR is accepted
alerts.immediateAction: freeze the affected exercise, preserve datadirs and logs, and open a security investigation

alerts.condition: no block for 60 seconds, P95 block interval exceeds 45 seconds, or a required peer is absent for 30 seconds
alerts.immediateAction: inspect miner hash rate, P2P admission and ASERT inputs; record the event for the acceptance report

alerts.condition: ingress exceeds 8,000 retained receipts, indexer lag exceeds two blocks, or rebuild exceeds five minutes
alerts.immediateAction: apply documented backpressure, retain receipts client-side, reconcile the index and do not silently discard work

alerts.condition: resource, proof-queue or verification-gas measurement exceeds the approved Phase 4 policy
alerts.immediateAction: reduce test load or pause the affected queue, preserve measurements and require an explicit policy disposition before continuation

evidenceRetention: Store public-safe aggregate reports with hashes; restrict raw logs, private evidence, keys and endpoints.
